item.title: Trump promised 'no more wars'. His foreign policy tells another story
item.description: Donald Trump promised an “America First” foreign policy and pledged to keep the US out of foreign wars. But since returning to the White House, his administration has been deeply involved in conflicts around the world. From the war in Ukraine and threats to Greenland and Canada, to the US intervention in Venezuela, Trump's shifting approach to the Middle East and war with Iran, Vedika Bahl examines his foreign policy record since returning to office. item.title: Are we overfertilizing our fields? Researchers challenge conventional soil testing
item.description: A new study led by Dr. Shikma Zaarur of the Hebrew University of Jerusalem, in collaboration with Dr. Ran Erel of the Agricultural Research Organization–Volcani Institute, reveals that agricultural soils may contain a substantial unaccounted-for reservoir of potassium, an essential nutrient for plant growth, that is largely overlooked by conventional soil testing methods. The findings could pave the way for more precise fertilizer recommendations, potentially reducing unnecessary fertilizer use while supporting sustainable agricultural production. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Trump abre dudas sobre una reanudación de los ataques a Irán a horas de las elecciones en EE. UU.
item.description: Donald Trump abrió este 2 de noviembre nuevas dudas sobre si cumpliría con la amenaza de reanudar los ataques contra Irán al afirmar que podría llegarse a un acuerdo. En las últimas semanas, Trump había insinuado la posibilidad de reanudar la ofensiva tras las elecciones de mitad de mandato estadounidenses. Este lunes dio a entender que podría estar reconsiderando su postura; pero, a última hora del día, medios de EE. UU. informaron de un ataque a la isla iraní de Qeshm. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: MAGA: Why Trump's most loyal supporters are turning against him?
item.description: Is Trump losing the support of the very coalition that brought him back to power?
